t: What Passive Radiative Cooling Paints and Fabrics Is
title: What Passive Radiative Cooling Paints and Fabrics Is
provenance: Public research knowledge: documented developments, published research, and established technical references. Real, fact-checked records.
description: Passive radiative cooling paints and fabrics are coatings that stay cooler than the air around them with no energy input: they reflect sunlight and radiate heat straight through the atmosphere's infrared window into space — air conditioning from a coat of paint. This record is the entry point of the teaching ladder for Passive Radiative Cooling Paints and Fabrics: start here, then move through the research state, the specifications, the public developments, the open challenges, and finally each piece needed to build it.
key_points: Passive Radiative Cooling Paints and Fabrics in one line: Passive radiative cooling paints and fabrics are coatings that stay cooler than the air around them with no energy input: they reflect sunlight and radiate heat straight through the atmosphere's infrared window into space — air conditioning from a coat of paint.
Why it matters: Cooling consumes 10% of global electricity; radiative cooling cuts it with zero energy..
Where it is used: buildings, vehicles, textiles, data centers, cold-chain..
Ladder rank 1 — the foundation. Everything else builds on this.
